### When Should We Praise God? (Psalm 66:17) - Your Daily Bible Verse - October 26
Author: Anne Peterson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-october-26.html
Passage: Psalm 66:17
Points:
- People often wait to praise God only after prayers are answered the way they desire.
- Biblical figures like the psalmist praised God simultaneously while crying out to Him for help.
- Jesus gave thanks to the Father before raising Lazarus, showing faith prior to seeing results.
- God's goodness is His constant character, not merely a reflection of favorable circumstances.
- Believers are invited to rely completely on God and honor Him with praise regardless of outcomes.
